Name: (CP) Customize Coffee Maker
Author: tikamin557
Description:
Add a coffee maker that allows you to customize the number of bean inputs, number of coffee outputs, etc. in detail yourself using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
There is also an omakase setting where you can set how many cups you want to make and the other values are set automatically.

Recipes will be mailed to you at "[color=#00ff00]Farming level 8[/color]", the same as "[color=#ffff00]Keg[/color]" recipe acquisition.

I will add the look of the machine (the table it is placed in) in the near future.

English and Japanese and Chinese are supported.

[size=3]Compatible with "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19188]Triple Shot Espresso (Grande)[/url]".[/size]
If installed, Triple Shot Espresso (Grande) can also output directly.


[color=#00ff00][size=5]Setting items in ModConfig.[/size][/color][color=#00ffff]

"How many cups to make?"[/color]
Set the number of cups of coffee to be made at one time in the "Customize Coffee Maker". The number of recipe ingredients, coffee bean input, coffee output, and working time are automatically set according to the number you set. If you want to customize them in detail, use the section below.
[color=#00ffff]
"Table Type"
[/color]You can change the look of the side table on which the coffee maker sits.(Currently there are 14 types.)[color=#00ffff]

"Random Table Type"
[/color]If you enable this setting, the above settings will be disabled and the appearance of the table will change randomly each day.[color=#00ffff]

[/color][color=#00ffff][color=#00ffff]"Machine Color"
[/color][/color]The color of the coffeemaker machine can be changed.(Currently there are seven colors.)[color=#00ffff][color=#00ffff][color=#00ffff]

"Random Machine Color"
[/color][/color][/color]If this setting is enabled, the above settings will be disabled and the machine will change color randomly each day.[color=#00ffff]

"Enable to Customize in Detail"
[/color]If enabled, the automatic adjustment of the "How many cups to make?" is disabled and the number of servings set in each of the following fields will be applied.[color=#00ffff]

"Recipe Materials Volume"
[/color]This is a setting for the number of materials required when creating a "Customize Coffee Maker". The amount of material will be the same as when creating the "Keg" for the set quantity. Enter an integer greater than or equal to "1".[color=#00ffff]
[/color](For example: 
If "1" is set, the materials needed to create the piece are... "Wood" (30), Copper Bar (1), Iron Bar (1), and Oak Resin (1).
If "5" is set, the materials needed to create the piece are... "Wood" (150), Copper Bar (5), Iron Bar (5), and Oak Resin (5).
it goes like this.)
[color=#00ffff]
"Input Bean Count"
[/color]Set the number of beans to be added to the "Customize Coffee Maker" at one time. Enter an integer greater than or equal to "1".[color=#00ffff]

"Output Coffee Count"
[/color]Sets the number of coffees created by the "Customize Coffee Maker". Enter an integer greater than or equal to "1".[color=#00ffff]

"Working Time"
[/color]Set the working time for the "Customized Coffee Maker". Enter an integer greater than or equal to "10" in increments of "10".(For example: "10" for 10 minutes, "120" for 2 hours, and "1200" for 20 hours.)

[color=#ffff00]"Enabling Additional Machines"[/color]
Enable additional machines. A separate machine is added and configured separately from the default machine so that it can be used separately from the default machine.

[color=#00ffff]"Steam and Bubbles"[/color][color=#00ffff]
[/color]Steam and bubble sounds and animations are played at the start of the operation and irregularly during the operation.[color=#00ffff]

"Wobble While Working"
[/color]When enabled, the working "Customize Coffee Maker" expands and deflates. (It works like many vanilla machines. Makes it easy to tell if it is running.)[color=#00ffff]

"Unlock Recipes"[/color]
By default, recipes for the "Customize Coffee Maker" are sent by mail when the "Farming Level" reaches "8". If you enable this setting, the recipes will be sent immediately regardless of the level.

Downloads.Description:
Added "Low Chroma Texture" to the ModConfig settings.
When this setting is enabled, the colors of machines and tables will be less saturated than normal. If you are using a recolor mod, using this setting may reduce the sense of incongruity.
